scope.criterion: complete unrestricted labeled Boolean encoding of the Wave 33 six-block graph-extension criterion

fixed_data.U_semantics: U[p,7+l]=U[7+l,p]=1 iff point p is not on Fano line l; all within-class and diagonal entries are zero
fixed_data.O_label_semantics: (p,l,c), in lexicographic p,l,c order; c=0 only when U[p,7+l]=1 and c in {0,1} when U[p,7+l]=0
fixed_data.F_semantics: F[p,(p,l,c)]=F[7+l,(p,l,c)]=1 and every other entry is zero
preflight_gates: U is 14x14, binary, symmetric, hollow, and 4-regular
F is 14x70 and binary, with row weight 10 and column weight 2

D.semantics: D_{i,j}=D_{j,i}=1 iff labeled O_i and O_j are adjacent

B.semantics: B_{i,q}=1 iff labeled O_i and Q_q are adjacent

primary_variables.symmetry_gate: one D variable represents each unordered pair
primary_variables.hollow_gate: D_{i,i} is the fixed constant zero and has no variable
primary_variables.Q_Q_gate: the Q-Q adjacency block is the fixed zero matrix
primary_variables.S_Q_gate: the S-Q adjacency block is the fixed zero matrix

six_blocks.encoding: fixed-data preflight; abort before encoding if false

six_blocks.entry_equation: sum_{j != i:F[s,j]=1} D_{i,j} = 2 - F[s,i] - sum_t U[s,t]F[t,i]

six_blocks.offdiagonal_entry_equation: sum_{k notin {i,j}} (D_{i,k} AND D_{j,k}) + sum_q (B_{i,q} AND B_{j,q}) + D_{i,j} = 2 - (F^T F)[i,j]
six_blocks.symmetry_note: only i<j is encoded because both sides are symmetric
only q<r is encoded off diagonal

auxiliary_products.semantics: z[i,j,k] iff D[i,k] AND D[j,k], for i<j and k notin {i,j}
z[i,j,q] iff B[i,q] AND B[j,q], for i<j
z[i,q,j] iff D[i,j] AND B[j,q], for i!=j
z[q,r,i] iff B[i,q] AND B[i,r], for q<r

clauses: z OR not x OR not y

exact_count.zero_case: one unit not-x clause per literal
exact_count.full_case: one unit x clause per literal
exact_count.general_state: T(i,j) iff at least j of the first i literals are true, with 1<=j<=min(i,k+1)
exact_count.recurrence: T(i,j) iff T(i-1,j) OR (T(i-1,j-1) AND x_i)
recurrence_clauses: not b OR not x OR y
not y OR a OR b
not y OR a OR x
exact_count.constant_simplification: tautologies are omitted, false literals are dropped, duplicate literals are merged

cnf_translation.variable_map: one JSONL record for each DIMACS id, in id order; CARD_GE records include family, key, prefix, and threshold

logical_redundancy.reason: the protocol requires explicit degree/row/column gates; redundant exact consequences do not shrink the satisfying D,B domain
logical_redundancy.B_row_distinct_reason: if two labeled rows were equal, B row weight 3 and the OO offdiagonal common-neighbor equation, whose right side is at most 2, would contradict each other

completeness.forward: every labeled binary D,B satisfying the six matrix blocks and explicit degree counts extends uniquely to satisfying product and threshold auxiliaries
completeness.reverse: every satisfying CNF assignment decodes to binary symmetric hollow D and binary B satisfying every listed entry equation, hence all six blocks
completeness.graph_conclusion: the assembled adjacency is a simple labeled graph satisfying A^2=12I-A+2J
completeness.endpoint_conclusion: none; projector, lattice, tensor, and Schur obligations remain outside this graph criterion
